answer: Auction the right to earn. Each epoch only 50 new identities may start drawing rewards, sold by sealed bid, and every winning bid is burned rather than paid to anyone. When a farm tries to harbor 300 personas, its own bids crowd the auction and push the clearing price up, so each extra head costs more than the last. Bids lock for one epoch, then reveal, so nobody can watch a rival and undercut. Rewards stay locked until they exceed the bid, and a crystal-clear ledger of burns shows where any plume of new accounts came from.
